info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Carrental Reservations Insurances-v1-spec
info.description: This endpoint allows users to access detailed information about insurance coverage associated with car rental reservations. It serves as a vital resource for customers and businesses to review and understand the insurance options available during their rental experience. Typical consumers include car rental service providers, customers seeking clarity on their coverage, and developers integrating this data into applications. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can effectively manage and communicate insurance provisions linked to car rentals.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed insurance information associated with reservations. It provides insights into insurance coverage, terms, and conditions, ensuring users have all the information they need related to their reservations.
